subject: Auth anomaly: IRP request and sanitized evidence package
messages:
From: Alex Turner <security@alphafin.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Sep 2028 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Auth anomaly: IRP request and evidence ask

Hi Vivek,

Wanted to notify you about a short-lived authentication spike we observed this morning affecting a small percentage of Alpha Financial users (approx. 0.4% over a 12-minute window). We're still investigating, but we need to gather a couple of things from Redwood for our SOC 2 evidence and our internal IR process:

- A copy of your current Incident Response Plan (IRP) or runbook that would be followed for auth anomalies
- A sanitized sample of authentication telemetry for the 2028-09-01 14:50:00Z - 15:10:00Z window (IP hashes, timestamps, user-id hashes; no PII)
- A short, high-level postmortem summary once available (redacted for customer identifiers)
- SIG/CAIQ mapping row for authentication controls you assert (if available)

Can you please confirm what you can provide and an estimated ETA? We need materials for our internal risk review by EOD Monday (2028-09-04). If we need an NDA/amendment for any temporary access, let me know.

For context, we've opened internal ticket AF-SEC-482.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Head of Security Engineering
Alpha Financial
security@alphafin.com

--
Attachment: screen-snapshot-AuthSpike.png (image/png, 240KB stub)

I think we should:
1) Produce a sanitized CSV sample (hash user ids, remove IPs or salt and hash, truncate tokens)
2) Package our current IRP (internal runbook) with a short cover letter describing what sections apply to auth anomalies

4) Draft a short (1-page) postmortem summary that omits customer usernames and any sensitive telemetry

Marissa — can you lead artifacts? Karthik — help with logs/telemetry redaction. Neha — please confirm if we need an external NDA addendum for additional access or if the existing contract language is sufficient.

I'll handle the external delivery once you confirm package contents.

Thanks,

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 1 Sep 2028 17:02:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Auth anomaly: IRP request and evidence ask

Alex — thanks for the heads up and the context. Please find the sanitized evidence package we prepared for your review:

Package contents (attachments and links):
- postmortem-summary-sanitized.pdf (attached) — 1-page summary with timeline, impact, and initial mitigations
- redacted-auth-telemetry-sample.csv (attached) — 250 sample rows covering 2028-09-01T14:50:00Z - 2028-09-01T15:10:00Z (IPs hashed + user ids salted & truncated)
- IRP-runbook-v3.pdf (attached) — excerpted runbook sections relevant to authentication events
- sig-caiq-mapping.xlsx (Drive link) — rows for authentication controls; public CAIQ rows referenced in cover note

Delivery method: Shared via a time-limited, view-only Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/redwood/alphafin-irp-sanitized (link expires 2028-09-08). For auditability we also created internal ticket SEC-234.

Summary of findings (high-level, non-sensitive):
- Timeline: transient spike observed 14:52–15:03Z, small fraction of sessions returned deliberate 429/403 responses consistent with rate-limited backend dependency. No evidence of credential exfiltration on initial review.
- Root cause: partial backend rate-limit misconfiguration triggered elevated retries and apparent auth churn. Further telemetry analysis ongoing.
- Mitigations applied: adjusted rate-limit rules, increased SLA routing for auth backend, added targeted alerting for MTTD improvement.

Redactions performed: removed customer-identifying metadata, hashed IP addresses (salted), truncated user_ids, removed any raw tokens. We ran a DLP scan and addressed flagged fields.

Next steps:
1) If you require any additional fields (e.g., full IPs under an NDA), please advise and we can discuss a temporary addendum and scoped access.
2) We'll follow up with a fuller postmortem by 2028-09-05 containing any new root-cause info and remediation verification.

Please confirm receipt and whether the current package meets Alpha Financial's needs for SOC 2 evidence. Happy to hop on a short call to walk through the artifacts if helpful.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
viv ek@redwood.com

Attachments: postmortem-summary-sanitized.pdf (application/pdf, 48KB stub); redacted-auth-telemetry-sample.csv (text/csv, 34KB stub); IRP-runbook-v3.pdf (application/pdf, 420KB stub)
